biomes.name: The Slabfields
biomes.notes: The Slabfields (was Mid Basin; renamed 2026-11-12). Between the Loom-Chasms' stretching and the Siphon Pits' squeezing: north of the hinge the Loom's warp chasms die out in the basalt benches; south of it lone slabs of flood basalt stand out of the flat bench plains, thrust up and tilted as Io's mountains are (a cliff on one face, a long ramp on the other, landslide aprons below): the Anvil, the split Halves with a patera in their gap, the still-tilting Leaner over the corridor road, the Backstop. The six breached maars, the loess-and-tuff corridor and the spring-fed paterae and chasm heads are the outposts' ground; Yuni outlaws roam it. biomes/slabfields/PLAN.md; scale model 5.1 edit 7.

biomes.name: rift rim S
biomes.notes: The S rim, the black rim (biomes/riftrim/PLAN.md section 3). Split from 'rift rim' 2026-10-23, with the west bend south of the w rift highland.

biomes.name: Stalker Gate
biomes.notes: Multi-branch meandering mountain and highland pass network connecting the Yuni Emirate, Stalker Range (Hub 01), Loom-Chasms, the Slabfields, and Siphon Pits around Lake Vapora.

biomes.name: High Rift
biomes.notes: Propagating eastern tip of the Great Rift between Oidong Valley and Siphon Pits: Opaline Sinter Staircase, North Mirror Graben (Lake Verdigris & Lake Cinnabar), Dorsal Wedge median horst, South Fire-and-Ice Coulee, and The Singing Gjar.

biomes.name: rift rim N
biomes.notes: The N rim, the glass rim (biomes/riftrim/PLAN.md section 3). Split from 'rift rim' 2026-10-23; its west end follows the w rift highland's border.

biomes.name: godshearth
biomes.notes: A caldera cut into the Godthrone's south flank: floor 3.6-3.75 km, walls 3-4 km high, the hot lake (3,642 m) and the spillway south. Climate (the owner, 2026-11-09): cools with height, 6 C per km from a floor of +7 C (warm month 15 C, days 24 / nights +6; cold month -2 C, days +7 / nights -10, to -18 C in the cold-air pools on clear nights): Cwb on the floor, Dwb on the benches, Dwc and ET on the rim. Rain 750-925 mm, about 70% of it in the warm half as afternoon storms, so the nights and the winters are clear (the model holds annual rain only). biomes/godshearth/PLAN.md.

settlements.name: Erehwon
settlements.notes: Pearl of Xanadu, 20,000 on its mountain lake (LORE.md 6.13; settlements/xanadu, target erewhon). Moved 2026-11-11 with edit 5.1-512, which remade its lake as an Atitlan-like caldera (121 x 66 km at -520 m, three volcanoes set back from the south shore, four islands; the Pleasure Dome of the Bay on its own small isle, landforms.json). The old pin 800,1503 is under the new lake. 805,1516 is a south-shore bench (-497 m): the town climbs to -415 m, a 90 m grey cliff to the palace plateau at -305 m, the mountainside behind, between the west and middle volcanoes 14 and 20 px back. Moved 2026-11-16 with its lake (the owner: "can we make the lake a little narrower and move it more toward the center of the valley? settlements can move with it") from 805,1516 to the same bench on the new south shore, 841,1517 (scale model 5.1 edit 7).

settlements.name: Gihon
settlements.notes: Sultanate Mint, Forbidden City garrison & Golden Tears Head House at Opal River mouth (settlements/gihon)

settlements.name: Kirstabal
settlements.notes: Xanadu Sultanate plantation town.

settlements.name: Longsong
settlements.notes: The History Monks' monastery on the south bank of the Bīruk al-Ghaym (r105, about 550 m3/s, 112 m wide) where it runs west-north-west down the Oidong Valley: the rock 356 m south of the river's centre as the open world draws it, the Great Gate's bridge crossing it. Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner, openworld/PLAN-SETTLEMENTS.md answer 10: 'Move the pin onto the 550 m3/s river') from 1226,1626, 11.7 km south-east; settlements/longsong (its frame turned 28.6 degrees so the river runs along its x axis), openworld/oidong-highrift.

settlements.name: Lāiṭwāl
settlements.notes: The Light Wall: a town of 5,000 on the north shore of Opal Valley's great lake, under the valley's north boundary fault. Half Glaziers in carved fronts up the wall (the eastern loj's main hold, kits/tungang PLAN 1.4), half Xanadui on the bench. The seat of Ōpal-Bhālī (P6). The Great Potch Line (Rift Black Opal) runs along the wall's foot. settlements/lightwall/PLAN.md (step L0; the owner, 2026-11-16).

settlements.name: Misṭ-Gārḍan (the Order of Viridian Thought's head monastery and tea estate)
settlements.notes: The head monastery of the Order of Viridian Thought (about 150) and the Sultanate's tea estate, on a bench cut into the Xanadu scarp's hillside (~792 m; the cell reads 813 m). A monastery: the map has no such type, so a village. Misṭ-Gārḍan (the Mist Garden) is a working name. The owner, 2026-11-16 ("keep going and ask for reshape"). settlements/viridian/PLAN.md (V1).

settlements.name: Opal Valley Mines
settlements.notes: From Gemini's trade model (openworld/world-pins-gemini.json, 2026-11-14). The owner, 2026-11-16: one of Lāiṭwāl's works villages, across Opal Valley's lake; no longer the province's seat (settlements/lightwall/PLAN.md).

settlements.name: Phēr
settlements.notes: The north shore's fair: a lake town of 6,000 on Erewhon's caldera lake, the lake's northern hub and the seat of Nōrth-Shor (P7), held by the Sultan's heir (the owner, 2026-11-16). The harbour and strand on the shore bench round a cove behind a headland, the town up the caldera wall, the fair ground and caravanserai on the rim; the Swīṭ Siṭrīm comes down to the cove. settlements/pher/PLAN.md (step P0), tools/scale-model/edit_517_pher.py; core/region/data/xan-tune.js places it here.

settlements.name: Qiblai
settlements.notes: Holy city of the Decree, ~12,000, under a council of abbots (kits/qiblai/PLAN.md; LORE.md 6.13). Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner: by a river, near plentiful resources) from 963,1566, 65 km from any river and without salt, 101 km to the cataracts of Nahr ash-Shalalat (~1,100 m3/s, the region's biggest river): flat ground for the 1.6 km mandala (37 m relief), rock salt, potash, rare earths, saltpeter, copper and oil within 30 km, farmland 40% (openworld/PLAN-SITES.md).

settlements.name: Red Monastery (Flashing Eye)
settlements.notes: Order of the Flashing Eye scoria-cone monastery (HM-06, settlements/flashing-eye) (A monastery: the map has no such stage, so a village.)

settlements.name: Singing Gjar Quartz
settlements.notes: From Gemini's trade model (openworld/world-pins-gemini.json, 2026-11-14).

settlements.name: Strongbow
settlements.notes: A cliff arcology of the Ancients hung in the scarp between the Oidong Valley and the Vale of Xanadu, the cliff the valley's river leaves by as a cataract (3 km south of it): its top on the lip at about 1,400 m, where the valley road ends, its foot on the Xanadu floor about 3,100 m below, so its elevator is the way between the two. Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner: 'a cliff arcology set in the side of a cliff'; 'by qiblai'; then 'right on the xanadu-oidong border - the same cliff the cataract is on - so that it offers a real advantage to anyone using its elevator') from 1026,1594, by way of 1298,1647 and 1013,1585 the same day; openworld/oidong-highrift.

settlements.name: Strongwall
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-12 (the owner: to the copper site) from 914,1634 (a 3x3 pit on the model) 13 km south to flat ground at 754 m, Cfb, 6 km from the rich copper band (240) at the scarp foot.

settlements.name: Thalaba
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-16 (the owner: "we can move thalaba to the mouth of godshearth and put a new village on the lake in its place") from 825,1481 to the bench at 1,450-1,700 m where Godshearth's spillway gorge opens (biomes/godshearth/PLAN.md); a town of ~2,400. Its old shore is Old Thalaba's.

settlements.name: The Beacon (the Order of the Beacon's head house; the Sultan's watch fort over the Rift)
settlements.notes: The Order of the Beacon's head house and the Sultan's watch fort over the Rift (the Marches' march.e), on the east shoulder's knoll (863 m; 885 m at 854,1540), its spur falling south to the Rift and a saddle behind it. Its lamp, 22 m up, sees G1 (the Brow post), the House of the Tempest, the Golden Tears' camp, Tuatara and the south watch fort. The owner, 2026-11-16 (all four recommended forks). settlements/beacon/PLAN.md (step B0).

A monastery: the map has no such type, so a village. settlements/strongwall/PLAN.md V0 (the owner, 2026-11-16); scale model 5.1 edit 9.

settlements.name: The Mist Garden's valley village
settlements.notes: The Viridian estate's farming village on the valley floor below the hollow: rice and grain, 100-200 people, on the floor's dry edge (181 m; Cfa, 1,800-2,000 mm). A core/hamlet farming village. The owner, 2026-11-16 ("keep going and ask for reshape"). settlements/viridian/PLAN.md (V1).

landforms.note: The Pleasure Dome of the Bay's island in Erehwon's bay: the Erewhon page's island (settlements/xanadu, target erewhon, ISLAND_C at 70,-613 m from the page's centre, which stands on Erehwon's pin 805,1516 unturned), about 220 x 110 m and 14 m over the lake, some 150 m off the world's shore (the owner, 2026-11-11: keep the page, move the record; it stays off the quays, about 0.6 km). No shoal: its rounded cell is the shore bench. Stamped at 1:1 by openworld/xanadu-oidong-highrift/src/44-world-landforms.js. edit_517 (first run as edit_512 on claude/openworld-sites, 2026-11-11).
